verdict.rationale: Column's reporting docs say transaction and summary reports are available in CSV, JSON, and Parquet, all open formats. Transfers can also be queried through a unified API endpoint, raw wire messages are retrievable, and monthly statements are produced automatically. This supports substantial self-serve data extraction, but nothing documents a complete 'export everything' path or how to leave the platform. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export covering all object types (customers/entities, cards, loans, checks, KYC records), any offboarding or account-closure/migration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
